description: Per-record verification cases: verify_record(candidate, prior, rules, state) equals the expected verdict.

cases.name: accept-request
cases.description: A User authors a Request from genesis.

cases.name: accept-capability
cases.description: A User grants a Capability after a Request.

cases.name: accept-action
cases.description: A Provider acts under an Auto capability it names via a Require ref.

cases.name: accept-result
cases.description: An Executor reports a Result for an accepted Action.

cases.name: accept-response
cases.description: A Provider responds within a Request's turn sequence.

cases.name: accept-approval
cases.description: A User grants a class Approval.

cases.name: accept-refusal
cases.description: A User refuses an accepted Action.

cases.name: accept-plan
cases.description: A Provider records an advisory Plan for a Request.

cases.name: accept-retraction
cases.description: The admin User retracts an earlier Summary.

cases.name: accept-signed-pinned
cases.description: A key-pinned User authors a validly signed Request.

cases.name: reject-request-wrong-role
cases.description: A Request whose author claims Provider instead of User.

cases.name: reject-unregistered-author
cases.description: A Request from an actor not registered in author_roles.

cases.name: reject-signature-missing
cases.description: A key-pinned actor authors an unsigned record.

cases.name: reject-signature-invalid
cases.description: A key-pinned actor signs with a key that is not pinned.

cases.name: reject-unknown-schema
cases.description: A record whose schema is absent from the rules' schema map.

cases.name: reject-kind-schema-mismatch
cases.description: A Request record carrying the Capability schema id.

cases.name: reject-non-canonical-payload
cases.description: A Request whose data bytes are valid JSON but not the exact JCS form.

cases.name: reject-request-missing
cases.description: A Response referencing a request id that is not in the log.

cases.name: reject-authority-ref-missing
cases.description: An Action that does not name any capability via a Require ref.

cases.name: reject-capability-denied
cases.description: An Action naming a Deny-mode capability.

cases.name: reject-approval-missing
cases.description: An Ask-mode Action with no matching approval.

cases.name: reject-ref-unresolved
cases.description: An Action naming a capability that was retracted before the action.

cases.name: reject-external-receipt-required
cases.description: A Result for an External-mode action that uses the internal Result schema instead of the external-receipt schema.

cases.name: reject-evidence-below-threshold
cases.description: A Summary whose derived evidence is weaker than the per-kind threshold.

cases.name: reject-capability-missing
cases.description: An Action for a class with no matching capability (a capability exists for a different class).

cases.name: reject-capability-expired
cases.description: An Action naming a capability whose expiry time has passed.

cases.name: reject-approval-expired
cases.description: An Ask-mode Action naming a class approval whose expiry time has passed.

cases.name: reject-action-closed
cases.description: A Result whose action id refers to a record that is not an open action.

cases.name: reject-replacement-invalid
cases.description: A Capability carrying a Replace ref to a Request (a different kind).

cases.name: reject-exact-approval-single-use
cases.description: A second Action reusing an exact approval that a first Action already consumed.
